title: ブライトお嬢様は怖いものなし？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I find myself visiting an amusement park owned and operated by Mejiro Bright's parents.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Ah, welcome, Miss Bright! This year's haunted house event is truly something! I guarantee that you'll jump right out of your skin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee! I'm very much looking forward to it. ♪ In fact, I'd like to experience it right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's been invited specifically to observe this year's haunted house before it opens to the public.

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text: Miss Bright has entered the venue! She's currently heading east at a walking speed of twenty-five meters per minute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Bright inside the attraction, I'm taken to the haunted house's control room. Stepping inside, who do I see watching the camera feeds but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Bright'll get spooked…
choice_data_list: What are you two doing here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We called you in as an advisor because we wanted to test our tactics on someone like Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's true, though. I don't think I've ever seen Bright surprised by anything.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Precisely! We've tried countless times to give Miss Bright a good scare inside our haunted house, but with no success whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Howwwever! We've truly outdone ourselves this year! Why, I'd say it's the finest work I've ever produced!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: This attraction's fright factor is so extreme that I anticipate even Miss Bright will have the time of her life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like this manager's whole career is riding on today's results. We turn to the monitors to watch Mejiro Bright's progress…

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text: Miss Bright has emerged from the abandoned hospital area, and she's smiling! Our first line of defense has been breached!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Remain calm! We anticipated a challenge! Prepare to deploy Madam Bloody-Muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, so the time's come. I wonder whether this will finally scare Bright…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She's a blood-splattered doll! Dober designed her face, and I oversaw the construction of her body!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She's horrendous even at first glance, and she's super realistic, so even Bright should be in for a shock!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Not yet! Wait until she's right at the drop point! In three, two, one—deploy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-thunk!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my… You're a doll, aren't you? I must say, you have quite the lovely face. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And your build is utterly robust. Why, your muscles are on par with those of my sister Ryan's, in fact. Teehee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text: Miss Bright is now petting the doll! I, I've never known a guest to behave like this…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …I may have made the doll's face prettier than necessary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I think maybe I was too particular about the muscles, too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright proceeds through the haunted house, casually taking its various surprises in her stride…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Um, Ryan? We're not the only ones here who know Bright fairly well…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! We've got another Bright expert right here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Her trainer might have the inside scoop on what gives Bright the heebie-jeebies!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer! Assume the role of chief frightener and scare Miss Bright, I beg of you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The manager goes briefly airborne before landing on all fours at my feet. Unable to refuse such an impassioned request, I find myself being taken to a small room…

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Wow, Trainer. You look horrifying… That's truly some Hollywood-level zombie makeup! It's as if you've been underground for years!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Now, it's time to put you before Miss Bright! Commence "Operation: Final T"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Go all-out! If you can dream it, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let me see… The exit door should be just around this corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kr-chak

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As instructed, I jump out in front of Mejiro Bright at the perfect moment and do my best zombie impression!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello there, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You're dressed as a zombie, aren't you? You look very authentic!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Care to accompany me to the exit? ♪ I'd love to see your makeup under proper lighting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Operation: Final T has failed…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Mejiro Bright leaves the haunted house, we come clean to her about our plan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So, yeah, sorry we kept all that a secret and tried to scare you, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Me too. I felt a little guilty about what we were doing, but the manager insisted I keep quiet…
choice_data_list: Sorry for going along with it!
Sorry for going along with it!
But you didn't get scared at all…
But you didn't get scared at all…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Me too. I felt a little guilty about what we were doing, but the manager insisted I keep quiet…
choice_data_list: Sorry for going along with it!
Sorry for going along with it!
But you didn't get scared at all…
But you didn't get scared at all…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In other words, the three of you were working together purely to give me a big surprise, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thanks to all of your efforts, I enjoyed my haunted house experience to the fullest. Thank you ever so much. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If I may, Trainer, regarding your costume and makeup…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Where might I undergo such a transformation myself? I'd love to experience being a zombie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Bright remains entirely oblivious to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Before I get around to feeling surprised, it takes me a few moments to realize something's actually occurring at all, you see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I might be more surprised if you explain in advance what's coming. Perhaps you could have made an announcement, such as, "Five seconds until the bloody doll."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our exploits aside, the haunted house ends up becoming a huge hit with the general public.
